messages:
Alex: Heads-up — we're launching 'example-runner' in docs next week. It's a sandboxed runner for interactive code snippets that issues ephemeral API keys scoped to a read-only demo model. No customer data leaves the sandbox. Goal: reduce friction for try-it-out examples.
Marta: Nice. What's the plan for existing examples that call external endpoints or require private creds?
Alex: We'll detect and mark those as 'offline-only' in the docs; they won't get runner buttons. Migration script will flag them. Timeline: soft launch 2026-04-02, full switch 2026-05-01. 60-day opt-out for authors.
Raj: Security notes: ephemeral keys TTL 15 minutes, rate-limited 10 req/min, strict CORS, strict model whitelisting. We'll add HMAC on runner handshake. Need a short threat model and sign-off by security before GA.
Sam: DevEx: adding a small CLI for local dev to emulate runner: `rw-example-runner start --local --port 9100`. We'll ship a docker-compose dev file. Also adding a 'Try in docs' toggle in the console for account-level enable/disable.
Marta: Docs work — I'll update the Interactive Examples guide and add a migration checklist. Who owns the migration script?
Alex: Assigning to @sam for the script; @marta will own docs copy. @raj will do security sign-off.
Sam: Will add a lightweight script: 
```
# sample config for example-runner
runner:
  ttl_seconds: 900
  rate_limit_per_min: 10
  allowed_models: ["redwood-demo-small", "redwood-embed-lite"]
```
Marta: For the docs page, we'll include a snippet showing how to detect offline-only: `data-example="offline-only"` and fallbacks for non-js readers.
devdocs-bot: Reminder — please file a tracking issue in docs repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues new:example-runner
Raj: Two ask items: (1) audit the demo models for PII hallucination vectors, (2) ensure logs are scrubbed and TTL'ed. I'll do (1) by 2026-03-30.
Alex: Ok — rollout checklist: security sign-off, migration script PR, docs update PR, console toggle behind feature flag, e2e tests for runner. If all green, soft launch 2026-04-02.
Marta: Will schedule a short cross-team sync Thursday 10:30PT and post minutes.
Sam: small note — for Dedicated/Private deployments runner will be disabled by default; we will surface docs on how to enable a self-hosted runner.
Alex: Thanks all. If anyone wants to test the alpha, ping me. :rocket:
Marta: tagging owners: @sam @raj @alex — adding to release calendar.
